authentication.web: HttpOnly SameSite cookie plus X-CSRF-Token on writes; native Authorization Bearer
authentication.workspace_selection: X-Workspace-ID authorized by membership; default workspace if omitted

database_seam: from .db import transaction, fetch_record, insert_record, update_record; from .security import require_session, Session; with transaction(session) as conn uses RLS; fetched record shape above; insert_record(conn, kind, data) and update_record(conn,kind,id,expected_revision,data); fetch_record(conn,kind,id)
session_seam: Session dataclass: user_id, workspace_id, role, csrf_token; require_session FastAPI dependency

documents.upload: POST /documents multipart file, optional farm_id and Idempotency-Key

source_imports.upload: POST /imports multipart file, grain, farm_id, format_profile, source_year:2026, delimiter:auto|comma|semicolon|tab; generic CSV still defaults to comma
source_imports.rows: GET /imports/{id}/preview then POST /imports/{id}/rows/review; saves proposals only
source_imports.meaning: Exact source column strings with separate source-year/holding/decimal review; no mapped parcel mutation, inferred certification, accepted upload format or government submission. Country-report row_schema is retained inside each snapshot.

facts.review: POST /facts/{id}/review {expected_revision,decision,note}; confirmation only by explicit actor

packs: GET /packs?country=DE&year=2026; GET /packs/{id}; static definitions under packs/*.json; actual mapping != reference only

reports.receipt: POST /reports/{id}/receipts {expected_revision,reference,date}; manual receipt not authority acceptance

report_transport.summary: Optional view=summary on report list/create, approval/reissue and fact/operation/sale report-dependency lists. Existing envelopes and default responses stay compatible. data.transport_view=summary contains compact report identity, status, checksum, approval, pack/farm metadata and counts, not full snapshots or source-validation arrays. Mutation projection follows idempotency handling.
report_transport.review: GET /reports/{id}?view=review returns compact record plus data.review {report_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint,sections,page_limit:5,byte_limit:2097152}, current can_approve, supported_formats and approval_blocked_reason. sections maps fields,operations,evidence,blockers,changes,receipts,reissues to exact counts. No eager section arrays.
report_transport.page: GET /reports/{id}/review?section=fields|operations|evidence|blockers|changes|receipts|reissues&expected_revision&snapshot_checksum&check_fingerprint&offset&limit<=5 returns {items,total,limit,offset,next_offset,section,report_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint}. Complete retained items only, serialized response bounded to2MiB; next_offset uses actual count and is null at end. Oversized individual items fail explicitly, never truncate. Dynamic sections also reject changed check fingerprints with409.
report_transport.approval: Native explicit approval sends expected_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint. Server revalidates current checks under existing locks; optional bindings do not weaken legacy approval checks. A missing/failed review page is not a complete review.
report_transport.files: Full immutable report downloads unchanged. Native report exports stream into private bounded temporary files before explicit OS sharing, with cancellation/account-switch cleanup; no whole-export JSON or byte-array caching.

web.api: apps/web/src/api.ts: get, post, patch, upload, download; post supports a stable idempotencyKey
web.components: apps/web/src/components.tsx; hooks.ts useRecords; auth.tsx useSession; offline.ts usePrivateDraft
web.module_exports: Core: HomePage/FarmPage/FarmDetailPage; RecordWork: RecordWorkPage; Requests/Documents/Reports: list and detail pages; ImportPage: ImportsPage; Adviser: AdviserPage; FieldsMap: FieldBoundaryWorkspace; Compliance: CompliancePage/UpdatesPage; Help: HelpPage; Community: CommunityPage; AssistantConnect: AssistantConnect; Support: GuidancePage/SettingsPage

countries.coverage: Common record workflows in EU27; country and regional mapping and official connections have explicit separate status.

authority_reads.hungary: hu-nebih-egn-read; operator-approved configuration and owner-supplied encrypted eGN diary token required
authority_reads.work: POST /connections/{id}/read-diary-operations {expected_revision,consent:true,field_read_id,site_id,use_id}; selected identifiers must come from the same connection revision's field read
authority_reads.meaning: Human-browser-only partial private snapshots, not confirmed facts or authority writes. Codes, dates and coordinates are not inferred; production interoperability remains unverified.

field_corrections.meaning: Private snapshots with retained parent lineage and review status; KML requires a valid outline for every parcel. No official LPIS write, authority acceptance or eligible-area claim.

compliance.profile: POST /compliance/farms/{id}/profile {year,expected_farm_revision,answers:[{key,value}]}; proposed typed answers, never auto-confirmed
compliance.checklists: POST /compliance/farms/{id}/checklist {rule_ids,year,expected_farm_revision,expected_input_fingerprint?}; draft checklists and open tasks
compliance.meaning: Source-backed evidence review, not legal certification, eligibility or authority acceptance

regulatory.worker: Bounded global public-source polling; per-actor farm relevance and read state stay tenant scoped
regulatory.meaning: A changed official page is a review signal, not an automatically effective legal rule

advice.qualifications: Self-declared until independent evidence review; expiry removes current reviewed status

assistant_connection.flow: S256 PKCE, browser-bound owner consent, exact allowed callback, rotating refresh tokens and revocable farm-limited read/propose access
assistant_connection.chat: GET /assistant/chat/status; POST /assistant/chat {farm_id,message,language,include_farm_context,history?}; optional local fallback, no autonomous actions

satellites.meaning: Measurements and proposed context, never confirmed farm operations or legal eligibility.

assistant.restriction: Dedicated ffa_ keys can only read or propose within selected farms. They cannot call native/account/approval/filing routes. All clients use the same server rules.

isolation: Server membership and PostgreSQL FORCE RLS; runtime role nonowner nonbypass. Original files private scoped UUID namespaces. Confirmed record revisions and issued reports immutable. Assistant credentials are additionally farm- and tool-limited. Government credentials require encryption, explicit setup and verified adapters; reference handoffs are never filing acknowledgements.
